title: B-tree reserve, transaction, and read-only observations

scope.rationale: Three small B-tree observations expose the live reserved trailer under an already-held shared mutex, the connection-local transaction state with null mapping to NONE, and the shared read-only flag. Together they form a dependency-free B-tree state observation boundary.
excluded_responsibilities: Read-only flag derivation from VFS open flags

external_source_responsibilities: B-tree lock discipline and state mutation owners
dependencies.caller_closure: All three observation bodies are assigned; public transaction/read-only consumers remain separately integrated.

inputs: Valid Btree for reserve/read-only observations; nullable Btree for transaction state
outputs: Live reserved bytes, NONE/READ/WRITE transaction state, and read-only boolean
contracts.ownership: All inputs are borrowed; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Null transaction input returns NONE. Reserve returns the live format reserve, not a pending larger request. Read-only returns the B-tree open-state flag.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Reserve requires the shared B-tree mutex already held; transaction requires the owning connection mutex for non-null input; read-only is a direct immutable-state observation. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Total for valid lock/state preconditions and has no error result.

representation_differences: Live reserve is stored directly as reserved_bytes rather than pageSize-usableSize.
The Zig Transaction enum names NONE/READ/WRITE states rather than exposing integer constants.
The Zig Btree owner stores read_only directly rather than in BtShared.btsFlags.

oracle.protocol: Seed a Btree with 12 reserved bytes, NONE transaction, and writable state; observe exact values and separately observe null transaction state.
oracle.normalization: Transaction enum values are compared semantically; reserve bytes and boolean are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; lock preconditions remain caller-owned.
assurance.malformed_input: Null is accepted only by transactionState; null reserve/read-only inputs are outside the source contract.

integration.native_call_path: Typed owners and initial scalar branches are unit-traced; native lock/public API wiring remains open.

independent_review.notes: Requires native locking/public integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect VFS-derived read-only state and public consumers.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/btree_core.zig page format, transaction, and Btree ownership were reviewed
callers: Read-only database APIs and mutation guards
Unit trace invokes each owner directly
callees: No production callees beyond direct state reads
assertions_branches_cleanup: All six active blocks are assigned
Null transaction conditional maps to NONE
upstream_tests: Upstream backup/reserve, transaction-state, read-only, URI, and VFS tests cover these observations
Project unit trace covers live reserve, null/non-null NONE transaction, and writable state
